object_description: three independent buildings arranged around a common square
design_condition: The three buildings are arranged around a common square facing the main course, improving western accessibility but placing a long school bar in front of the existing courtyard and obstructing distant views.

positive.statement: The decision to separate the main functions into three houses is appreciated.
The system allows users to experience the school as a campus with distinct locations for the main activities.
The four interior courtyards provide overhead light and breathing space for students.
The expression of the buildings is convincing and gives the project an institutional character.
The facades present nuances specific to each activity without affecting the overall reading.

negative.statement: The long school bar in front of the existing courtyard is regrettable.
The entrance porticos of the two other houses seem narrow.
The sports house raises questions because of its ungenerous entrance space and changing rooms spread over four floors.
The presence of classrooms on the ground floor was questioned.
The strong presence of the learning house closes the perspective from the existing courtyard towards the distant landscape.
